about: The voice rule (SpeechGoldenTest, Speech.kt): `chooseVoice` gives the index of the voice to speak with, or null. `speechRate` is SPEECH_RATE.

chooseVoice.name: en-NZ device takes the en-NZ voice first of three
en-NZ device with en-GB, en-NZ voices takes the en-NZ one
en-NZ device with only en-GB and en-US takes the first given
an en_NZ voice tag matches an en-NZ device locale
a Unicode extension on the device locale is ignored
two en-US voices take the first
fr-FR then en-AU device with an en-AU voice takes it
fr-FR device only, an en-US voice is still taken
a bare en device locale takes the first English voice
a bare en voice is English
a script subtag is skipped to reach the region
